skins.name: Marionette's Id
skins.content: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Marionette's Id. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. By her own fingers she will puppet the strings, unseal the closed box, and grant freedom to every doll.
skins.usage: One of Mutsumi Wakaba's Terran stage costumes.
skins.quote: Fearing not death, she confronts her each and every self.
